desc:
🧪 Your character is an active ragdoll: a real physics body that keeps itself standing with its own muscles.
Nothing is faked. Every step, stumble, hit and fall is simulated, so your body reacts to everything it touches. Get pushed too far and you lose your balance, your muscles go limp, and you flop to the ground for real. Press jump to get back up.

💪 YOUR BODY, YOUR PHYSICS
• Climb ladders and walls with nothing but your hands
• Grab props, push heavy crates, or pick up your friends
• Every body is different: its weight, grip and momentum all count
• Knock others over and watch them tumble

🧪 THE LAB
Test your ragdoll on crazy physics machines: a slam hammer, punch machine, plinko, tumble drum, spinners, catapult, ski jump and more. Then fire yourself out of a cannon, swing from a grapple hook, crash a kart, or loop a swing.

🎮 Ten minigames and hidden stunt spots to find.
